question: Will you run the rebaseline command today to activate the disk-capacity update?
big_picture: The disk-capacity update is built and tested, but it changes how stored data is written in five control-plane areas. Only you can approve the install because the stored-data contract changes. If you run it and tell me, I finish the install checks; if you hold or do not answer, the current install stays and disk capacity remains inactive.
reason: The update is built and tested, and running it activates disk capacity.

options.label: I will run it today, then tell you to finish the install checks
Hold — keep the current install and leave disk capacity inactive

technical_details: The installer stopped because of changes to the persistent-state contract in disk capacity, resources, process records, managed services, and operator state. This is the second request in five days (11 Nov and 15 Nov 2026). A possible installer-guard change needs its own operator decision. If run: the operator runs the exact command shown on the page in a terminal on the Vrooli computer; after the operator reports completion, the install agent finishes installation checks. If hold or unanswered: current installed version remains, disk capacity is inactive, and work continues on source only.
